preconditions.description: Attacker must hold at least numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity (500,000 * 10^6 * 10^18) of the PLENTYCOIN token
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens from fees to trigger swapAndLiquify (balanceOf(address(this)) - _lockedAmount >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity)

exploit_hint: Trigger the swapAndLiquify function by making a transfer that causes contractTokenBalance >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity. The vulnerable transfer(_buyBackAddress, rest) call in swapAndLiquify() will use msg.sender (attacker) as the from address instead of the contract address, transferring rest tokens from the attacker's balance to _buyBackAddress. To exploit, ensure you have sufficient token balance, then make a transfer that triggers the automatic swapAndLiquify execution (from != uniswapV2Pair, to any address). The attacker will lose tokens to _buyBackAddress, but this demonstrates the vulnerability where user funds are incorrectly used instead of contract funds.
